features: Schema v3 DMI Expert can now be published directly to the R2 Active model through the existing internal model/active endpoint
Direct Active publication archives the previous Active model before replacement and writes an Active manifest with schema/DMI metadata
If the newly published Active model is also the current Challenger, that duplicate Challenger slot is cleared automatically
HistoricalTraining publish-current-model workflow now publishes the already-trained Schema v3 model as Candidate and immediately as Active, then verifies R2 readback
No 90-symbol historical replay is rerun; S-state rules and DMI formulas are unchanged
After publication, the next Full Analysis uses probability_reader Schema v3 DMI Expert corrections for success/survival/true-fail probabilities
